proposed_prediction.claim_family: First-person indexed subjectivity gate versus higher-order access
proposed_prediction.observable: Dissociation between HOT-style higher-order access and QICN ownership, continuity, perspective, intervention-response, and irreducibility margins.
proposed_prediction.manipulation: Run matched baseline, HOT-positive/QICN-ablated, QICN-structural/HOT-weak, label-only, memory-only, narrative-only, history-blind, sham, off-target, self/non-self swap, ownership-flattening, continuity-fracture, and decoy-insertion conditions under frozen seeds and hash manifest.
proposed_prediction.framework_prediction: QICN receives bounded support only if first-person indexed gate variables add preregistered incremental value over HOT variables, all QICN thresholds pass, and all negative controls fail the QICN gate.
proposed_prediction.rival_prediction: HOT is favored if higher-order access variables predict the target while QICN ownership, continuity, intervention, or irreducibility margins fail, are non-identifiable, or add no incremental value.
proposed_prediction.support_condition: QICN variables produce at least 5 percent cross-validated loss reduction over HOT-only model, Delta BIC >= 10 or bootstrap-confirmed equivalent, all QICN thresholds pass, and CTRL_PASS_RATE = 0.
proposed_prediction.weakening_condition: HOT_HOA predicts the target while QICN variables are unstable, threshold-dependent, autocorrelation-limited, or significant only after post-hoc transformations.
proposed_prediction.destruction_condition: Any selected negative control passes the QICN gate, or HOT-only/weak-rival model matches or beats QICN at equal or lower cost while ownership and continuity margins fail.

thresholds.name: HOT_HOA
thresholds.rationale: Requires higher-order access to be both discriminative and calibrated before it can act as HOT-positive condition.

thresholds.name: QICN_SIPM
thresholds.rationale: Separates privileged self-locus assignment from symmetric or decoy-sensitive assignment.

thresholds.name: QICN_OFIA
thresholds.value: paired standardized effect d >= 0.50; block-bootstrap CI excludes 0
thresholds.rationale: Tests whether self-owned perturbations differ from matched non-self perturbations.

thresholds.name: QICN_CFS
thresholds.rationale: Separates continuity burden from mere memory persistence or sham perturbation.

thresholds.name: QICN_FPPG
thresholds.rationale: Requires indexed model to outperform index-neutral factorized rival under matched intervention budget.

thresholds.name: QICN_WRI
thresholds.value: Delta BIC >= 10 or cross-validated loss gain >= 5 percent
thresholds.rationale: Prevents QICN gate from surviving when HOT-only or weak-rival reconstructions match it at equal or lower cost.

thresholds.name: CTRL_PASS_RATE
thresholds.source: QICN Negative Control Suite v1 and Phase 6.3A protocol
thresholds.rationale: Any selected negative control passing the QICN gate destroys the target-level claim.

proposed_prediction.epistemic_limit: This proposed prediction tests a bounded operational dissociation target only. It does not validate consciousness, phenomenality, human equivalence, metaphysical subjecthood, runtime certification, or external adjudication.
